title: Best Event Planners for Hire (2026): Online and In-Person Events
description: How to hire an event manager or planner for conferences, webinars, launches or parties: planning scope, vendors, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Event managers plan and coordinate events: virtual webinars, hybrid conferences, product launches, workshops, team retreats or celebrations. Remote freelancers often handle planning, schedules, vendor research, registration and run-of-show documents, while local teams handle on-site work. Events go wrong when the budget is unclear, vendors are not confirmed in writing, or nobody owns the details on the day. This guide helps you hire planning help that keeps your event calm and organized.

faq.q: Can an online freelancer plan an in-person event?
faq.a: Yes, for planning, research, schedules and coordination. On-site work usually needs local staff or vendors.

faq.q: What does an event plan include?
faq.a: Typically goals, budget, timeline, vendor list, schedule, run-of-show and checklists.

faq.q: Do they book and pay vendors?
faq.a: Usually you sign and pay vendors directly. The planner researches and coordinates.
Many manage webinar platforms, speakers, rehearsals and attendee communication.
The larger the event, the earlier. Venues and speakers often book months ahead.
